about_short_description.short_description: Arab African International Bank provides banking, credit cards, payroll, corporate finance and wealth management services.

product.name: Corporate Banking
product.description: Provides financial services including lending, treasury, trade, cash management, and global transaction banking tailored for corporate clients.

product.name: SME Banking
product.description: Offers financial solutions, advisory, and support tailored to small and medium-sized enterprises to support their business development.

product.name: Retail Banking
product.description: Provides personal banking services including checking accounts, savings accounts, credit cards, and online banking for individual customers.

product.name: Wealth Management
product.description: Delivers personalized financial advice, investment management, and banking services for high-net-worth individuals.

product.name: Leasing Services
product.description: Offers leasing solutions to support financing needs for equipment and assets across various industries.

product.name: Mortgage Finance
product.description: Provides financing solutions for property acquisition and real estate development.
